verdicts.reason: Both demote the RSVP CTA to a tag-sized pill in the same row as Free Entry/All Ages/Tastings, scatter the details in tiny 8px text, and leave a stray red fragment after Tastings. A has the worse reading order: the 'Reserve a spot' line and the subhead open at the far left, 'Solstice Presents' sits after the headline, and the logo is stranded at the far right next to the date details. B at least opens with the logo, but the logo is jammed into the top-left corner with no margin, the time and place float under it with no grouping, and the subhead sits in the far-right corner.
